request: Configure Claude and Codex Notion MCP access for the current project only.
title: Configure project-scoped Notion MCP
purpose: Allow Claude Code and Codex to discover the Notion remote MCP server only while working in this repository.

files.purpose: Allow Claude Code and Codex to discover the Notion remote MCP server only while working in this repository.
files.previous_behavior: Codex had no repository-scoped Notion MCP endpoint.
files.new_behavior: Trusted Codex sessions opened from this repository discover the Notion streamable HTTP MCP server without changing the user-level Codex configuration.
files.data_impact: none: this file stores only a public MCP endpoint and does not read or modify Notion workspace data.
files.access_control_impact: Notion access remains gated by each user's OAuth approval; no token or workspace grant is stored in the repository.
risks: Codex ignores project configuration when the repository is not trusted, and an existing session must be restarted before discovery.
files.rollback: Remove .codex/config.toml and restart Codex; revoke the Notion OAuth grant separately if authentication was completed.

production_safety.operational_data: No Notion or application production data was read, created, updated, or deleted.
production_safety.schema_migration: none: no database or application schema was changed.
external_side_effects: Claude and Codex project configuration files were created or updated locally; no OAuth consent was granted and no remote workspace mutation occurred.

verification.command: Python json and tomllib parse of .mcp.json and .codex/config.toml
verification.evidence: Both project configuration files parsed successfully.
Claude reported Project config with the expected HTTP endpoint and Pending approval status.
Codex parsed the same table as an enabled streamable_http server; the official manual confirms project .codex/config.toml is loaded for trusted repositories.

residual_risks: Claude still needs project-server approval and Notion OAuth consent in an interactive Claude session.
Codex needs a restarted session and Notion OAuth authentication before tools can access a workspace.
